name: Advanced Header Field
description: Provides a customizable field type for heading text and optional subtitle.
project_description: This module provides a heading field that separates the semantic meaning of a heading from its visual style. Content editors often pick the wrong tag for SEO/accessibility just to get a particular visual size; this field lets them choose the semantic tag (h2-h6) independently of a visual size class and additional style classes. Built on top of the core Link field, so any heading can optionally become a link, and every value (heading text, subtitle, link, options) is stored in a single field table. A companion advanced_header_field_navigation submodule adds an in-page jump-menu block driven by opted-in headings.
